answer: Hardware-root binding ties each identity to verifiable hardware: at registration every key is co-signed by a rooted module whose serial is logged once in the timber registry and never reused. The trigger fires when cluster review surfaces two identities sharing one hardware root; the rule burns 24,000 POA per fake identity across both bonds. A thousand clones rooted from one factory therefore forfeit 24,000,000 POA to the vault, while an honest operator walking the river with a distinct hardware key passes free, its attestation chain growing like a willow branch.
